text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 321
APPROPRIATING THE NECESSARY FUNDS TO PROVIDE FOR THE ENLARGED COURT OF
APPEALS PURSUANT TO PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 289 DATED SEPTEMBER 7, 1973
WHEREAS, Presidential Decree No. 289 dated September 7, 1973, has increased the membership of the
Court of Appeals from twenty-four to thirty-six Associate Justices;
WHEREAS, both Presidential Decree No. 233 (Appropriation Decree for FY 1974) and Presidential Decree
No. 289 have not provided the necessary appropriations for the enlarged Court of Appeals; and
WHEREAS, it has been estimated that there is need to appropriate an amount of ONE MILLION SIX
HUNDRED EIGHTY FOUR THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED EIGHTY PESOS (P1,684,680.00) in addition to
the current appropriation of the Court of Appeals in Presidential Decree No. 233 to meet the additional
expenses occasioned by the enlarged membership of said appellate court;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081 dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1 dated September 22,
1972, do hereby order and decree the appropriation of the total amount of ONE MILLION SIX HUNDRED
EIGHTY FOUR THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED EIGHTY PESOS (P1,684,680.00), or so much thereof as
may be necessary, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to meet the additional
expenses of the enlarged Court of Appeals for the period from October 1, 1973 to the end of fiscal year
nineteen hundred and seventy-four; and thereafter, such amount as may be necessary shall be incorporated in
the subsequent appropriations Act for the Court of Appeals.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
